meta.policy: Rules are frozen before evaluation. Validated requires a recorded per-play no-vig baseline, an exact binomial or Poisson-binomial test, Holm multiple-comparison control, and a passed bomb-dependency check. Rolling monthly results are retained for stability review.

source_backlog.name: CFB kickoff-time systems
source_backlog.path: CFBD historical start times; 7:00 p.m. ET threshold frozen before testing.

source_backlog.name: Pregame ranking systems
source_backlog.path: Poll published before the game; final-season rankings are prohibited.

source_backlog.name: P4 / G5 / FCS systems
source_backlog.path: Season-specific conference and subdivision labels joined by game ID.

source_backlog.name: Historical weather systems
source_backlog.path: Kickoff wind, temperature and precipitation; indoor games excluded.

source_backlog.name: External systems intake · Trendsperts
source_backlog.path: Public rule definitions are leads only. THI independently rebuilds the sample, line convention, price, holdout and prospective record before publication. The current Discover board exposes four CFB cards and no CBB cards.

source_backlog.name: Coach and prior-meeting systems
source_backlog.path: The visible Trendsperts CFB lead uses coach identity, home-favorite status and previous-meeting result. THI needs chronological coach-tenure and prior-matchup joins before an honest backtest; a 13-game outside sample is not promoted.

source_backlog.name: True reverse line movement
source_backlog.path: Requires synchronized ticket percentages and sharp-book price snapshots.
